$$q=(-2,-1)\in T_A^{\mathrm{original}},$$
and the complete constructor gives
$$T_A^{\mathrm{original}}\cap E_A=\varnothing.$$
Thus  $A$  cannot itself own  $q$ . In particular, it includes every intermediate inward support, as well as the outward support at each even terminal row and the support beyond each terminal tip.
